# Tasks: Install-time HOME.md Scaffold

STATUS: All tasks complete (Slice 1 + Slice 2 + Closure Checklist), all `[x]` in `openspec/changes/install-home-scaffold/tasks.md`. A subsequent fresh-review fix batch (4 commits, TDD, not new tasks.md items) closed 2 MEDIUM + 2 LOW findings in Slice 2 — CRLF/trailing-space heading detection, CLI I/O exit codes, adapter doc table, adapter test hardening. See `sdd/install-home-scaffold/apply-progress` for the full implementation record and commit list.

## Review Workload Forecast

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Estimated changed lines | ~450 total (Slice 1 ~230, Slice 2 ~220) + review-fix batch ~120 |
| 400-line budget risk | High for single PR; Low per slice |
| Chained PRs recommended | Yes |
| Suggested split | PR1 (Slice 1 — scaffold) → PR2 (Slice 2 — index helper + adapter rewire + review fixes) |
| Delivery strategy | feature-branch-chain |
| Chain strategy | feature-branch-chain |

### Chained-PR Branch Plan (feature-branch-chain)

- Tracker: `feature/install-home-scaffold` — accumulates both slices; only this merges to `main`
- PR1: `feature/install-home-scaffold-s1` → targets tracker — Slice 1 complete, 5 commits
- PR2: `feature/install-home-scaffold-s2` → targets PR1's branch — Slice 2 complete (4 commits) + review-fix batch (4 commits)

Both slices fully implemented and tested (820/820 `npm test` pass on Slice 2 branch tip, after review-fix batch). Next: PR2 fresh review → open PR2 → merge chain → sdd-verify → sdd-archive.
